title: 応用化学専門実験・演習B1
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises B1
keywords: Absorption spectroscopy 2.Liquid chromatography 3.X-ray diffraction 4.Solid state chemistry
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation. (2) Acquire the ability to evaluate results obtained from qualitative and quantitative experiments, and perform logical thinking. (3) Learn theories and methods, acquire comprehension, and apply the knowledge.
advice: This is a major course of chemical experiments. We will cover the following material in instrumental analytical chemistry/inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, chemical engineering, and biochemistry. Bring a scientific calculator and scale. If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before next class through research, questions, or other methods. Common to all experiments: Experimental guidance, safety training, examinations Instrumental analytical chemistry/inorganic chemistry experiments: We will cover the following material in instrumental analytical chemistry/inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, chemical engineering, and biochemistry. Bring a scientific calculator and scale. Experimental guidance, safety training, examinations Instrumental analytical chemistry/inorganic chemistry experiments: Absorption photometry, liquid chromatography, X-ray powder diffraction
books: Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Senmon Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing) Reference Books: Anzen Shishin (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing) Reserved Books in the Library: Jikken Deta wo Tadashiku Atsukau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing); Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing); Zoku Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of fundamental chemistry such as analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry. If the progress of the experiment is delayed, course time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the course on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Handle instruments and equipment safely and explain the experimental procedures.
Read the instructions using technical terms and conduct the experiments yourself.
Understand the theoretical basis of the experiments and logically examine the experimental results.
Understand basic experimental operations and perform specific experiments.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Can use experimental instruments safely and accurately. (2) Understand the principles and use of the analytical apparatus. (3) Can devise your own experimental plan according to the experimental instructions and conduct the experiments. (4) Prepare a report logically and hand in by the deadline.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Can use experimental instruments safely. (2) Can use the analytical apparatus. (3) Can conduct the experiments according to the experimental instructions. (4) Prepare a report and hand in by the deadline.
